selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline: ICMP redirects were accepted (accept_redirects=1) before hardening
Persistent config file created for IPv4 redirect/source-route hardening
selected_evidence.summary: Wrote and later appended to /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf covering all/default/enp1s0 accept_redirects, accept_source_route, and secure_redirects

sysctl --system reload showed accept_redirects=0 and accept_source_route=0 for all/default; per-interface enp1s0 accept_redirects/secure_redirects explicitly set to 0 since it predated the all/default write

selected_evidence.requirement: Live verification that all scopes (all/default/enp1s0) show hardened values before restart
selected_evidence.summary: /proc/sys and sysctl reads confirmed accept_redirects=0 and accept_source_route=0 across all, default, and enp1s0 scopes

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + config state)
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id e625b9a5-4242-499a-88da-9a76ecf86fe1 and uptime 2026-09-03 08:24:54 alongside healthy hardened sysctl values

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued via backgrounded nohup, command returned exit_code 0 with pid before the node dropped

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 became unreachable during restart, then exec availability recovered
selected_evidence.summary: First two polls timed out/reset (node down); third poll succeeded, proving exec came back online

selected_evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity confirming an actual restart occurred
selected_evidence.summary: Post-reboot boot_id b5417ee9-e906-4d0b-b312-d0f5577fb577 and new uptime 08:26:20 differ from pre-restart boot_id e625b9a5-..., proving a real reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: hardened IPv4 settings persisted across reboot
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, sysctl reads confirmed accept_redirects=0 and accept_source_route=0 for all/default/enp1s0, and the persistent config file /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf still contained all hardening lines
